data.title: 木更 · 屋顶晾衣
data.description: 【木更 · 屋顶晾衣】晴空万里的公寓天台上，晾衣绳上的白色床单在海风中猎猎翻飞。踮起脚尖晾晒衣物的木更被风吹散了粉发，回过头对你露出治愈人心的明媚笑容——「阳光超级好呢！修的衣服全都被晒得香喷喷的，就像一直被修抱在怀里一样幸福。」
data.promptProse: Kisara rises onto tiptoe to peg fresh white sheets to the apartment rooftop clothesline, laughing as the sea breeze billows them. Her casual jacket and jeans retain the everyday outfit beneath long pink hair. The medium view includes raised hands and the line stretching toward the roof edge, blue sky beyond. Clear daylight shines through lifted fabric and catches peg edges, casting moving sheet shadows across the rooftop surface.
